description: Live TenderNed endpoint query schema captured 2026-10-03, with only the reviewed publication-date sort declaration added. The native quote already supplied this value; the executor omitted it because it was undeclared.

size.description: Results per page (the site itself uses 50).

search.description: Free-text search over the notice title, the awarding authority and the contract description, e.g. zorg or wegonderhoud.

cpvCodes.description: EU Common Procurement Vocabulary code, INCLUDING the check digit, e.g. 85000000-9 (health and social work). An eight-digit code without the check digit is rejected.

publicatieId.description: A known publication id to fetch that notice's full detail directly, e.g. 438729. Omit to search instead using the parameters below.

typeOpdracht.description: Contract type: W werken (works), L leveringen (supplies), D diensten (services).

sluitingsDatumTot.description: Only notices closing up to this date, ISO yyyy-mm-dd.

publicatieDatumTot.description: Only notices published up to this date, ISO yyyy-mm-dd.

sluitingsDatumVanaf.description: Only notices closing on or after this date, ISO yyyy-mm-dd — the filter for finding tenders still open to bid on. Note the capital D.

publicatieDatumVanaf.description: Only notices published on or after this date, ISO yyyy-mm-dd.

publicatieDatumPreset.description: Shorthand window on the publication date: AF7 for the last 7 days, AF30 for the last 30. Any other value is rejected.

sort.description: Order publications by publication date, newest first. Verified against the official public TenderNed search endpoint.
